narrationTexts: Confirms it: only the 3 rows with both a discount and tax fail. Fixing `orderTotal` to tax the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 total, 625 passing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Only rows with both a nonzero discount and tax exposed it, so 3 of 625 cases failed.

Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. No other suites had issues.
